description: This Java source file defines the JNDIContextFactory class, which provides methods to obtain and manage JNDI initial contexts based on server configurations. It includes caching of contexts and utility functions for context retrieval and cache clearing.

classes.name: JNDIContextFactory
classes.description: A utility class that provides static methods for retrieving and managing JNDI InitialContext instances, including caching for efficiency.

methods.name: getInitialContext
methods.description: Returns the JNDI InitialContext corresponding to the given server name, creating and caching it if necessary, with configuration parameters obtained from external configuration files.

methods.name: clearInitialContext
methods.description: Removes the cached InitialContext for the specified server name from the internal cache.
